== Formatting

Constrained *strong*, _emphasis_ and `code`; unconstrained **str**ong, __em__phasis and ``co``de.

Replacements: (C) (R) (TM) -- and ... and the arrows -> <- => <=.

Press kbd:[Ctrl+S] to save, click btn:[OK], then menu:File[Save As].

continues on the next.
